## RE:volution Mod v1.3.9

### Added

- In-Location mob-stage transition points with explicit safe server-side destinations.
- Forward/backward 180° trigger halves derived from stage geometry, with per-Location `offset/radius` configuration.
- Data-driven `locked`, `forward`, and `backward` transition messages with a 20-tick delayed teleport and cancellation when the player leaves the trigger context.
- Manual `/stage next`, `/stage previous`, `/stage teleport`, and per-player `/stage auto` transition controls without bypassing progression.
- Cascading `/stage revoke` and `/stage reset` progression administration.
- Transition geometry in the existing mob-zone overlay.
- Player navigation menu on `L` for Location → unlocked mob/stage teleport selection.
- Canonical `/stage location ...` namespace for mob-zone setup while retaining `/custommob location ...` as a legacy compatibility alias.
- Location-wide transition trigger and message configuration plus Tab completion for transition message sides.

### Fixed

- Transition movement now revalidates progression and destination safety on the server before teleporting.
- Pending automatic transitions are cancelled when trigger context, auto mode, or configuration is no longer valid.
- Non-contiguous configured stage IDs remain compatible with next/previous progression navigation.
- Locked stages cannot be reached through the player teleport menu or direct transition requests.

### Other

- Progression remains owned by mob stages; transition logic remains a separate player/Location concern.
- Trigger dimensions are uniform across stages within one Location, while different Locations may use different sizes.
- Existing v1.3.8 per-player progression, contribution, reward, HP rollback, Realm isolation, and managed-mob behavior remain unchanged.
- The next planned technical iteration is v1.3.10 Test Foundation for JUnit-based regression infrastructure.

### Download

The release build will produce `RE-volution-1.3.9.jar` after release promotion and final stable verification.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.3.8...v1.3.9
